page.content:
Nazi genocide of Europe's Jews and the murder of millions of others.

How Holocaust connects

  • Faction: Nazi Germany — The Nazi state organized the Holocaust.
  • Character: Adolf Hitler — Hitler's regime conceived and ordered the genocide.
  • Location: Auschwitz — Auschwitz was a central killing and labor complex of the Holocaust.

What is Holocaust?

The Holocaust is the systematic murder of six million Jews, with millions of other victims of Nazi racial and political killing. Camps, ghettos, and shooting units were the machinery; it is central, not incidental, to the Nazi war.

Key threads lead to Nazi Germany, Adolf Hitler and Auschwitz.
